app.name: WiiFlow Kids
app.long_description:
WiiFlow Kids is a fork of WiiFlow Lite stripped down to a single screen a young child can use on their own.
All Wii and GameCube games appear together in one coverflow. Point at a game, press A, then press PLAY. That is the whole interface.
The old WiiFlow menus - source, settings, categories, favorites, delete, downloads, WAD manager, NAND emulation, disc dumping - are removed from the build entirely, not just hidden. HOME simply exits WiiFlow.
There is no settings UI: configure by editing wiiflow.ini by hand.
Based on WiiFlow Lite by Fledge68.
